description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and a class related to evaluation components such as datasets, evaluation results, evaluators, and evaluation runs in a software project. It includes data structures and methods for converting evaluator entities to DTOs and vice versa.

classes.name: EvaluatorDTO
classes.description: Data Transfer Object class for Evaluator entities, including methods to convert between entity and DTO representations.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a plain object into an Evaluator entity, setting its config based on the evaluator type.

methods.name: fromEntity
methods.description: Creates an EvaluatorDTO from an Evaluator entity, parsing its config JSON into DTO properties.

methods.name: fromEntities
methods.description: Converts an array of Evaluator entities into an array of EvaluatorDTOs.
